description: This script automates the process of searching for repositories with the 'fastapi' topic on GitHub, comparing repository data, updating a local YAML file with the repository info, and creating a pull request with these updates. It involves configuration management, GitHub API interaction, file I/O, and subprocess commands for Git operations.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Defines configuration settings for GitHub repository and token, using Pydantic's BaseSettings.

classes.name: Repo
classes.description: Represents essential information about a GitHub repository, including name, URL, stars, and owner info.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates fetching GitHub repositories, updating a YAML file, and creating a pull request with the changes.
